description: This source file defines classes, interfaces, and functions for handling calendar events within an Android application. It includes data models, permission checks, querying, adding, and serializing calendar events using Android's CalendarContract APIs. The main class is CalendarHandler, which manages calendar event operations and JSON parsing.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class for requesting a list of calendar events within a specific time range and limit.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class for adding a new calendar event with details like title, time, location, and calendar info.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event record with identifiers, titles, ISO start/end times, and metadata.

classes.name: CalendarDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checks, fetching events, and adding events to the calendar.

classes.name: SystemCalendarDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of CalendarDataSource using Android's CalendarContract for real calendar operations.

classes.name: CalendarHandler
classes.description: Main class handling calendar event operations including querying, adding, and JSON serialization. It enforces permissions and manages lifecycle.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if app has permission to read calendar.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if app has permission to write to calendar.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events matching the given request.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event based on the provided request.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Handles a request to fetch calendar events, returns JSON result or error.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Handles a request to add a calendar event, returns JSON result or error.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEventRecord into a JSON object.
